name: Earth & Climate Atlas
desc: A detailed, interactive course through university Earth and climate science: from minerals, rocks and plate tectonics to landscapes, water, the atmosphere, the oceans and ice, Earth history and the climate system.
desc_zh: 深入、可交互的大学地球与气候科学课程：从矿物、岩石与板块构造，到地貌、水、大气、海洋与冰冻圈、地球历史以及气候系统。
lede: A detailed, interactive course through university Earth and climate science — from minerals, rocks and plate tectonics to landscapes and water, weather and the atmosphere, the oceans and ice, Earth history and the cycles of the elements, and the climate system, past and present. This is a skeleton: the courses and chapters are mapped out, and the lessons are still to be written.
lede_zh: 深入、可交互的大学地球与气候科学课程——从矿物、岩石与板块构造，到地貌与水、天气与大气、海洋与冰冻圈、地球历史与元素循环，以及过去和现在的气候系统。目前这是一个框架：课程与章节已经规划好，课文尚待编写。
foot: a free, detailed and interactive tour of the undergraduate Earth and climate science curriculum, written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks.
foot_zh: 一套免费、详尽、可交互的大学本科地球与气候科学课程导览，可配合课堂和教材阅读。
about_lede: Earth & Climate Atlas is a free, detailed tour of the Earth and climate science taught in a university degree — written to be read alongside lectures and textbooks, or on its own.
about_lede_zh: 地球与气候图谱是一套免费、详尽的大学地球与气候科学导览——可以配合课堂和教材阅读，也可以单独自学。
timeline_desc: From Hutton’s deep time to plate tectonics and the science of climate change: the discoveries behind every course in the atlas.
timeline_desc_zh: 从赫顿的深时观念到板块构造和气候变化科学：图谱中每门课程背后的发现。
timeline_title: Timeline of Earth and climate science
timeline_title_zh: 地球与气候科学时间线
timeline_lede: The discoveries behind the courses, from Hutton’s deep time and Tyndall’s measurements of greenhouse gases to plate tectonics, ice cores and climate models. Coloured dots show the area; links lead to the course where the idea is taught.
timeline_lede_zh: 各门课程背后的发现：从赫顿的深时观念和丁达尔对温室气体的测量，到板块构造、冰芯与气候模式。彩色圆点表示所属领域；链接指向讲授该内容的课程。
card_desc: University Earth and climate science: the Earth system, minerals, rocks and tectonics, geophysics, landscapes and water, the atmosphere and weather, oceans and ice, Earth history, biogeochemistry and climate change. The curriculum is mapped out; the lessons are still to be written.
card_desc_zh: 大学地球与气候科学：地球系统、矿物岩石与构造、地球物理、地貌与水、大气与天气、海洋与冰冻圈、地球历史、生物地球化学与气候变化。课程体系已经规划好，课文尚待编写。

areas.label: Earth system & methods
areas.blurb: The planet as one system, and the tools used to observe, map and protect it.
areas.blurb_zh: 把地球作为一个整体系统，以及观测、测绘和防护它的工具。

areas.label: Solid Earth
areas.blurb: Minerals, rocks, plate tectonics, the planet’s interior and other planets.
areas.blurb_zh: 矿物、岩石、板块构造、地球内部以及其他行星。

areas.label: Surface processes & water
areas.blurb: Landscapes, sediments, water and resources at and below the surface.
areas.blurb_zh: 地表与地下的地貌、沉积物、水和资源。

areas.label: Atmosphere & weather
areas.blurb: The air: its physics, chemistry, motion and weather.
areas.blurb_zh: 大气的物理、化学、运动与天气。

areas.label: Oceans & ice
areas.blurb: Seawater, ocean circulation, sea level and the frozen world.
areas.blurb_zh: 海水、海洋环流、海平面与冰冻世界。

areas.label: Climate
areas.blurb: How the climate system works, how it has changed and how it is changing.
areas.blurb_zh: 气候系统如何运作、过去如何变化以及正在如何变化。

areas.label: Earth history & life
areas.blurb: Deep time, the record of life and the cycles of the elements.
areas.blurb_zh: 深时、生命的记录以及元素的循环。
